# The words the inflection is held to, and what it must make of them.
#
#   <word> <plural> <singular>
#
# One line per word, blank lines and # comments ignored. Every line is a claim
# about the answer a reader would give, not about the answer the code currently
# gives: a row that fails is either a bug in the dictionary or a bug in the
# rules, and which one it is comes from what forge explain says answered.
#
# Two properties are checked over every row rather than written out per row:
# pluralising twice changes nothing, and the singular of the plural of a word
# that is not already plural is the word again.

# The four the old three-rule inflection got wrong, and said so.
Person       People        Person
Child        Children      Child
Datum        Data          Datum
Epoch        Epochs        Epoch

# Irregulars a domain model reaches for without thinking.
Analysis     Analyses      Analysis
Matrix       Matrices      Matrix
Leaf         Leaves        Leaf
Hero         Heroes        Hero
Criterion    Criteria      Criterion
Medium       Media         Medium
Half         Halves        Half
Life         Lives         Life
Mouse        Mice          Mouse
Foot         Feet          Foot
Quiz         Quizzes       Quiz
Axis         Axes          Axis

# The regular rules, which the dictionary must not be reached for at all.
Category     Categories    Category
Box          Boxes         Box
Address      Addresses     Address
Day          Days          Day
Status       Statuses      Status
Alias        Aliases       Alias
Photo        Photos        Photo
Node         Nodes         Node
Index        Indexes       Index
Schema       Schemas       Schema
Class        Classes       Class
Church       Churches      Church
City         Cities        City
Journey      Journeys      Journey

# Words already plural, which is what keeps Aliaseses from being written.
Aliases      Aliases       Alias
People       People        Person
Children     Children      Child
Data         Data          Datum
Statuses     Statuses      Status

# Words with no plural at all.
Series       Series        Series
Metadata     Metadata      Metadata
Info         Info          Info
Sheep        Sheep         Sheep
Police       Police        Police

# Initialisms take a small s and never es. OS is the one that had to be
# decided: a bare s, so that the singular is an exact inverse and so that the
# handful of initialisms ending in a sibilant — OS, DNS, TLS, HTTPS — are
# spelled by one rule rather than by an exception nobody would look up.
ID           IDs           ID
IDs          IDs           ID
URL          URLs          URL
API          APIs          API
OS           OSs           OS
UserID       UserIDs       UserID

# Only the last word inflects, and everything before it is left alone.
HomeAddress  HomeAddresses HomeAddress
NodeChild    NodeChildren  NodeChild
ChildNode    ChildNodes    ChildNode
LeafValue    LeafValues    LeafValue

# A word the dictionary has never heard of takes the regular rules, which is
# the right answer for nearly every domain word there is.
Widget       Widgets       Widget
Blob         Blobs         Blob
Frob         Frobs         Frob

# The case a name was written in is the case it comes back in.
person       people        person
PERSON       PEOPLE        PERSON
address      addresses     address
